summary: The §9.4 trim clip (vendor/truck/truck-certified/src/kernel/trimclip.rs) is landed with the packet's public API: TrimLoop { chart, curve: BezierLeaf1, closed }, CertifiedCrossing, CertifiedExclusion, OffLoopCert, certify_crossings, certify_off_loop, winding_number, and trim_clip(graph: &CertifiedGraph, trims: &[TrimLoop]) -> Construction<CertifiedGraph>. Steps 3-6 of §9.4 are implemented verbatim: per arc's pcurve and each closed trim curve IN THE SAME CHART, certified R9 crossings are isolated by R9System + krawczyk_c1 (the S1A seam) with subdivision to DEPTH_MAX and the engine's one-line ResidualId::R9 re-stamp; each is a TopoNode::TrimCrossing node (Rule A holds by construction: per (pcurve, trim) residual the certified boxes are pairwise disjoint and each root is unique per §8.2); arcs are split at the certified crossings; every sub-arc is classified inside/outside by the winding number of the closed trim loop about one certified-off interior sample, where the sample's off-loop property is certified by R9 distance-positivity data (certify_off_loop: the cross-multiplied point-vs-trim residual components of the R9 family certified to exclude zero over a partition of the trim parameter); outside sub-arcs are discarded. The winding is an exact integer ray-crossing count in the plane with certified sign discipline (Bernstein-coefficient hulls, degenerate point sign evals, and i64 sums — polynomial arithmetic only, N4: no sin/cos/atan2/exp/ln/log/powf/sqrt and no angle function). Failure to isolate at DEPTH_MAX refuses TrimClipFailed (Inconclusive) with predicate names trim_crossing_depth_max / sample_off_loop_depth_max / winding_*. The interior-loop no-special-case case is handled by steps 3-6 with no special case. kernel/mod.rs wires `pub mod trimclip;`. The seven required tests live in tests/kernel_trimclip.rs and all pass. Commit 1c7bcaf at the worktree root. RESULT.json is at the worktree root.

measured_counts.crossing_fixture: diagonal line vs quadratic trim: exactly 1 certified crossing, certified (t, r) box contains (1/3, 1/3) (root non-dyadic, off every subdivision boundary below DEPTH_MAX); certified chart point is the pcurve image of the certified t-midpoint.
measured_counts.split_fixture: horizontal chord y = 0.3 across the closed cubic loop: 2 certified crossings (boxes [0.34375, 0.375] and [0.625, 0.65625] in the arc parameter); leading/trailing outside runs discarded, 1 inside run retained between the two TrimCrossing nodes.
measured_counts.interior_loop_fixture: closed square ring [0.42, 0.58] x [0.2, 0.62] strictly inside the chart (missing every leaf boundary) crossing the closed loop: 2 TrimCrossing nodes at (0.58, 0.446) and (0.42, 0.446); bottom side retained whole, lower runs of the two vertical sides retained, top side and upper vertical runs discarded (3 arcs retained).
measured_counts.winding_fixture: inside sample (0.5, 0.3): certified winding +1 (matches the independent dense angle-sum reference); outside samples (0.5, 1.2) and (0.1, 0.3): winding 0. Off-loop certificates carry 7-16 certified exclusion boxes partitioning the trim parameter.
measured_counts.depth_max_fixture: parabola C1(t) = (t, (t - 0.25)^2) exactly tangent to the horizontal trim C2(r) = (r, 0) at the contact (0.25, 0.25): the R9 residual vanishes there but its Jacobian is singular, so no box containing the contact isolates a transverse root; the subdivision stalls at DEPTH_MAX 40 and certify_crossings refuses TrimClipFailed (Inconclusive, predicate trim_crossing_depth_max). The fixture is NOT supposed to isolate (a tangent contact has no crossing), so the refusal is the deliverable, not a stop condition.

blocking_finding.text: None. All seven required tests pass. The trim-clip module's honest scope is recorded in-module: the frozen CertifiedGraph carries no polynomial pcurves, so like tier1::boundary_seeds (caller-supplied edge leaves), an arc is clippable exactly when its certified trace in the trim chart is the straight segment between its two certified chart endpoints, which trim_clip recovers exactly as a degree-1 BezierLeaf1 (the leaf/atlas wave supplies general pcurves). A straight certified trace whose R9 events cannot be recovered is refused TrimClipFailed (Inconclusive). No frozen seam was touched; the winding uses only polynomial sign evaluations (no transcendental evaluation, so the §9.4 SOUND use of the winding index holds). Pre-existing baseline note: the crate's kernel_tracer.rs retains its three documented S4A partial failures (dtau_grows_on_success_and_halves_on_failure, escalation_routes_isolated_r2_to_the_contact_future, high_order_singularity_refuses); they are untouched by this packet.
